titre: White hid his king. Black mates in 3! ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Petrov Defense: White tucks the king in the corner. Knight sacrifice with check, the pawn must take because the bishop covers the other square, then the queen checks and mates. Seen in 3 real Lichess games (puzzle rated ~1840). Would you have sacrificed the knight? 👇
